evidence.quote: Reproduces the missing-id failure pattern from prod

observations.why: Flat assertive statement of what the test does — asserted as fact, no hedging, but no ratification or operational settling language to lift it to decision.

evidence.quote: Must not crash; must produce a valid slug.

observations.why: Operational rule stated as a settled requirement the speaker expects to hold — 'must' twice ratifies the constraint as load-bearing, not merely argued for.
